about.title: Global Brands in the Mongolian Market
about.intro1: Since 2013, we have operated as the official distributor of international brands, delivering certified world-class products to consumers and beauty professionals in Mongolia through official channels.
about.intro2: We are a distribution company that officially imports, distributes, and sustainably develops international brands in Mongolia. Beyond importing, we comprehensively provide brand marketing, sales, logistics, customer consulting, professional training, and partner support.
about.intro3: Today, we officially represent world-class brands including ESTEL Professional and SYNERGETIC, dedicated to sustainably enhancing product accessibility, professional service, and brand value.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To thoughtfully cultivate world-class quality brands in the Mongolian market, delivering reliable products, professional service, and lasting value to consumers.

culture.title: Official Standards, Quality, and Long-Term Partnership
culture.description: In our daily operations and decision-making, we are guided by five fundamental corporate values.

valuesList.title: Official Standards
valuesList.text: We strictly adhere to the official rights, standards, and verified product specifications of our partner brands.

valuesList.title: Uncompromising Quality
valuesList.text: We deliver authentic, certified products sourced directly from original manufacturers.

valuesList.title: Professionalism
valuesList.text: We provide expert guidance, technical consulting, and professional education on optimal product application.

valuesList.title: Customer First
valuesList.text: Beyond sales, we empower customers with comprehensive information to make well-informed, safe choices.

valuesList.title: Long-Term Partnership
valuesList.text: We foster durable, mutually beneficial relationships with brand owners, dealers, salons, and consumers.
